description: Full details of one Morizon.pl listing: price and price per m² (PLN), area, rooms, floor, year built, property type, transaction and market, the address with district and coordinates, seller type and name (agency or developer; private owners are not named), the listing's detail tables as shown on the page (Polish labels and values: condition, rent and charges, building type, heating, ownership, available from…), amenities, the full description and photo URLs. No phone numbers. Get the id from morizon_search. Fetched live from Morizon.pl's own API (typically under 1 s). Result: { source, fetchedAt, listing: { source, id, url, title, active, property_type, transaction, market, kind, development, price, price_per_m2, currency, area_m2, rooms, floor, year_built, address, geo, seller_type, seller_name, agent_name, date_posted, updated, details, amenities, description, photos }, note? } — `note` is set when the listing is no longer active.

id.description: The listing's id (e.g. 'mzn2047996834') or its full https://www.morizon.pl link, as returned by morizon_search.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

name: morizon_offer
title: Get one Morizon.pl listing
